MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey)+collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS ks
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people
WHERE size(people)>=2
RETURN count(i) AS n, count(DISTINCT pr) AS pc

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey)+collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS ks
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people
WHERE size(people)>=2
UNWIND people AS id
RETURN DISTINCT id, 'person' AS kind

MATCH (i:Issue)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey)+collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS ks
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,pr,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people
WHERE size(people)>=2
RETURN DISTINCT pr.projectKey AS id, 'project' AS kind

MATCH (i:Issue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey)+collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS ks
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people
WHERE size(people)>=2
RETURN i.issueKey AS issue

MATCH (i:Issue)
OPTIONAL MATCH (i)-[:ASSIGNED_TO|REPORTED_BY|CREATED_BY]->(p:Person)
OPTIONAL MATCH (q:Person)-[t:LOGGED_TIME]->(i) WHERE t.seconds>0
WITH i,collect(DISTINCT p.personKey)+collect(DISTINCT q.personKey) AS ks, collect(DISTINCT t.historyId) AS ts
UNWIND ks AS k
WITH i,ts,collect(DISTINCT k) AS people
WHERE size(people)>=2
UNWIND ts AS te
RETURN DISTINCT te AS time_entry
